fact: The World Bank says about 79,142 Sudanese households (close to 400,000 beneficiaries) received their first monthly payment of the government-implemented Sudan Family Support Program (Thamarat) through cash cards by 3 March 2021, about $1.9 million in total.
Sudan's finance ministry says Council of Ministers decisions 149 and 150 require workers' entitlements to be paid through bank accounts, and that this has been put into effect.
